title: Trey Hendrickson, Chris Olave, Chase Young are expected to play in Ravens-Saints

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Trey Hendrickson, Chris Olave, Chase Young are expected to play in Ravens-Saints
sources.description: The Ravens will be without wide receiver Zay Flowers for Sunday's game against the Saints, but they are set to have linebacker Trey Hendrickson in the lineup.
